Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we have alignment on Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private:

What we heard from your side:

- Current pilot is on a hosted shared API using a 13B open model; evaluating 70B-class model for higher fidelity.
- Compliance: SOC2 in-scope, considering Private VPC if procurement requires perimeter isolation.
- Workload profile (rough): expected peak ~200 requests/sec, with 40–60 concurrent in-flight chats during peaks. Typical prompt ~50–200 tokens, typical response 150–400 tokens, plus ~20% of calls are longer summarization jobs that can go up to ~2k tokens.

Questions we flagged for sizing: GPU family preference (A100/H100), whether you need single-tenant isolation (Private VPC) vs Dedicated (reserved GPUs w/tenant isolation), and bursting behavior (how often you need 2–3x peak).

Attached: fintechco-prod-token-mix.xlsx (the token mix spreadsheet you shared) — Rafael and Aditya, looping you in to provide a sizing estimate and options.

Proposed next steps:
- Rafael to provide initial GPU sizing estimates (H100 vs A100 tradeoffs) and a short cost/throughput ballpark.
- Alicia to confirm whether procurement will require a Private VPC contract or whether Dedicated with encrypted networking is sufficient.
- Schedule 30-min follow-up next week to review sizing worksheet and procurement questions.

Would Friday 6/25 or Monday 6/28 work for a 30-min?

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up — initial sizing estimates

Hi Alicia / team —

Thanks for the token mix and clear targets — below are our initial, conservative sizing recommendations based on the numbers you provided (200 sustained RPS, occasional 300 RPS spikes, ~50–70 concurrency, token mix as stated). These are intentionally conservative to give headroom for caching inefficiencies and KV warmups.

Summary recommendations (options):

1) Recommended (70B production focused):
- Hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB (or equivalent H100-PCIe) in a Dedicated pool.
- Model config: 70B quantized (q8_k or q4_k depending on eval) with KV cache enabled.
- Expected throughput: ~180–220 steady RPS for single-model serving per cluster with ~60 concurrent sessions for chat-style calls (avg 280 tokens per request round-trip).
- Long jobs: schedule on separate priority queue/backfill nodes or run on the same cluster with autoscale buffer (recommended 1 extra H100 for heavy 2k-token jobs).
- Latency: median p95 generation latency ~220–350ms per token depending on sequence length and quantization.
- Notes: H100 gives better throughput and future-proofing for larger context lengths; fewer GPUs required vs A100 but higher cost per GPU.

2) Cost-balanced alternative (mixed 13B + occasional 70B):
- Hardware: 6x NVIDIA A100 80GB.
- Model config: primary traffic on 13B or 34B for lower-latency flows; route fidelity-critical flows to a 70B pool.
- Expected throughput: combined cluster throughput ~250–300 RPS for mixed traffic (13B dominates), with lower per-request latency for 13B calls.

- Latency: 13B p95 generation latency ~80–140ms per token; 70B on A100 p95 ~300–450ms per token.

3) Minimal pilot (cost-conscious):
- Hardware: 2–3x A100 80GB, run 13B in prod and evaluate 70B as a canary.
- Use autoscale + burst policy for short 2–3x spikes; recommend a burst credit pool to avoid cold starts.

Operational notes & questions:
- Caching: if your front-end reuses prefixes (lots of repeated prompts), effective throughput can be 1.3–2x higher with prefix caching enabled. Please confirm reuse patterns.
- KV warmup: long-tail cold KV states for large context sizes will add latency; we recommend a small warm pool if you have many long-context sessions.
- Private VPC: we can support Private VPC with customer-managed KMS and private peering. That path has a slightly higher lead time (additional networking and legal review) vs Dedicated. If Procurement needs this, please share the procurement_contact and we can route docs.
- Region: please confirm preferred region (us-west-2 / us-east-1) — GPU availability affects whether we recommend H100 vs A100 for launch.

Attachments: rdw-sizing-estimate-20270620.pdf (PDF summary), rdw-deployment-options.md (deployment comparison).

Next steps: I'll populate the sizing worksheet with the three option rows and a rough cost range per month and share before Friday's call. If you can confirm the percent traffic to 70B and preferred region, I can finalize the estimate.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
